name: activationZone
meaning: ACTIVATIONZONE box; its y extent is moved in place with the platform; objects overlapping it are carried

name: bodyBox
meaning: model box 0 (model-space) used by the load test

name: door
meaning: DOOR object, translated by -delta (moves opposite the platform)

name: mechanism
meaning: IDMECHANISM object (DoorMechanism): msg 0x21 while moving, 0x22 on arrival

name: targetY
meaning: indexed by WoodenPlatForm_GetLoad: [0] rest (start pos.y), [1] halfway, [2] -MINZVALUE

name: disabled
meaning: 1 when there is no ACTIVATIONZONE; Update does nothing
